verdict.rationale: Wave's public pages describe accounting reports such as P&L, balance sheet and cash flow. Nothing in the evidence shows a general ledger or trial balance being pulled through an API, or in what format. The crawl note says the developer portal hosting Wave's GraphQL API returned 403, so no API documentation could be quoted, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats
